map.默认示例：几何体积 = 10×5×2 = 100 m³；实际容水 = 100×9: Default example: geometric volume = 10×5×2 = 100 m³; actual water capacity = 100×90% = 90 m³ (≈ 90,000 L); at 0.8 kg/m³ the maximum carrying capacity is ≈ 72 kg. Cylinders, cones and other shapes convert the same way with their own formulas (πr²h, (1/3)πr²h and so on).
map.为什么要乘填充率？: Why multiply by the fill ratio?
map.池体不宜全满，留安全余量防溢流与便于增氧布气，实际容水小于几何体积。: A tank should not be filled to the brim; leaving a safety margin prevents overflow and eases aeration and gas distribution, so the actual water capacity is less than the geometric volume.
map.密度 0.8 kg/m³ 怎么理解？: How should a density of 0.8 kg/m³ be understood?
map.是经验载鱼密度上限，受增氧与换水能力制约，精养可更高但需配套设备。: It is an empirical upper limit on carrying density, constrained by aeration and water-exchange capacity; intensive farming can go higher but needs the matching equipment.
